description: Keenable web search with reproducible research, citations, and a local evidence trail.

tools.name: fetch_fetch
tools.description: Extract clean content (markdown) from a web page URL. Required: url. Optional: max_chars (default: 50000), live (default: false), prompt. Returns the FetchResponse.

params.name: url
params.description: URL of the page to fetch

params.name: max_chars
params.description: Maximum number of characters of content to return. Longer content is truncated and a notice is appended after the cut, so the response runs slightly past this number.

params.name: live
params.description: Fetch the page live from the source instead of returning Keenable's indexed copy. Enables fetching URLs that are not indexed.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Optional extraction instruction. When set, an LLM reads the fetched page and the response content is only the output for this instruction instead of the full page. Example: 'List all pricing tiers with their monthly prices'.

tools.name: fetch_public
tools.description: Keyless twin of GET /v1/fetch. Same query parameters and same response, no API key. Rate limited per IP rather than per organization, and consumes no credits. Required: X-Keenable-Title, url. Optional: max_chars (default: 50000), live (default: false), prompt. Returns the FetchResponse.

params.name: X-Keenable-Title
params.description: Name of the application making the call. Required on the public endpoints; without it the request is rejected with 400 'Missing app identifier'. Longer values are truncated. The keenable_title query parameter carries the same value when a header is not an option.

params.name: url
params.description: URL of the page to fetch

params.name: max_chars
params.description: Maximum number of characters of content to return. Longer content is truncated and a notice is appended after the cut, so the response runs slightly past this number.

params.name: live
params.description: Fetch the page live from the source instead of returning Keenable's indexed copy. Enables fetching URLs that are not indexed.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Optional extraction instruction. When set, an LLM reads the fetched page and the response content is only the output for this instruction instead of the full page. Example: 'List all pricing tiers with their monthly prices'.

tools.name: web_search_search-post
tools.description: Perform a web search using a JSON request body. Supports date filters and site restriction. Required: query. Optional: acquired_after, acquired_before, max_results (plus 5 more). Returns array of SearchResult.

params.name: acquired_after
params.description: Filter: pages acquired after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601, or relative like '7d')

params.name: acquired_before
params.description: Filter: pages acquired before this date. A bare YYYY-MM-DD includes that whole day (up to 23:59:59.999 UTC); pass a timestamp to cut at an exact instant

params.name: max_results
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. When omitted, up to 10 results are returned.

params.name: published_after
params.description: Filter: pages published after this date

params.name: published_before
params.description: Filter: pages published before this date. A bare YYYY-MM-DD includes that whole day (up to 23:59:59.999 UTC); pass a timestamp to cut at an exact instant

params.name: query
params.description: Search query

params.name: query_time
params.description: Search the index as it stood at this point in time: pages acquired after it are excluded. A bare YYYY-MM-DD resolves to 00:00:00 UTC. Relative deltas on the date filters are computed from this instant instead of the request time

params.name: site
params.description: Restrict results to a specific domain

params.name: snippet_max_length
params.description: Maximum length, in characters, of the snippet returned per result. When omitted, a default snippet length is used.

novel_features.name: Reproducible research snapshot
novel_features.description: Save an exact search and fetch run as an immutable local evidence snapshot.

novel_features.name: Snapshot replay
novel_features.description: Rerun a saved research recipe and report how current evidence changed.

novel_features.name: Citation bundle export
novel_features.description: Export source-linked Markdown or JSON citations from a saved research run.

novel_features.name: Bounded multi-page fetch
novel_features.description: Fetch a bounded URL list with concurrency limits and explicit partial failures.

novel_features.name: Offline local FTS recall
novel_features.description: Search saved titles, snippets, URLs, and Markdown without spending an upstream request.

novel_features.name: Result and content drift comparison
novel_features.description: Compare saved runs for URL changes, rank movement, metadata edits, and content-hash drift.

novel_features.name: Domain and source coverage report
novel_features.description: Measure domain diversity, rank share, timestamp coverage, and missing metadata in a saved run.
